# Happy Spicy Hour

> > Your complete guide to spicy food, heat levels, and pepper substitutes with interactive tools and comprehensive culinary references.

Happy Spicy Hour is a spicy food resource site featuring interactive calculators, comprehensive pepper and spice databases, and comparative guides on heat levels, flavors, and culinary applications. The site combines scientific explanations of capsaicin and other heat compounds with practical cooking tools and global cuisine comparisons.

## Key Topics

- Scoville Heat Units (SHU)
- Capsaicin
- Chili Peppers
- Ghost Pepper
- Carolina Reaper
- Piperine
- Jalapeño
- Cayenne
- Heat Levels
- Pepper Substitutes
- Sichuan Cuisine
- Thai Curry
- TRPV1 Receptors
- Spice Database
- Culinary Reference

## Interactive Tools & Calculators

- [Scoville Scale Calculator](https://happyspicyhour.com/scoville-scale-calculator): Free tool to calculate Scoville Heat Units (SHU) for spicy dishes.
- [Pepper Substitute Finder](https://happyspicyhour.com/pepper-substitute-finder): Interactive tool finding substitutes for 72 chile peppers with heat ratios.
- [How Spicy Is That Dish?](https://happyspicyhour.com/how-spicy-is): Database of 200+ dishes with SHU ratings and heat level comparisons.

## Spice & Pepper Reference

- [List of Herbs and Spices A-Z](https://happyspicyhour.com/spices): Comprehensive A-Z reference guide to 119 herbs and spices.
- [Spicy Foods Tier List](https://happyspicyhour.com/spicy-foods): Ranked tier list of 162 spicy dishes by Scoville Heat Units.

## Pepper & Heat Comparisons

- [Ghost Pepper Powder vs Carolina Reaper Powder](https://happyspicyhour.com/ghost-pepper-powder-vs-carolina-reaper-powder): Comparison of Ghost Pepper and Carolina Reaper powders with heat levels.
- [Pink Peppercorn vs Black Peppercorn](https://happyspicyhour.com/pink-peppercorn-vs-black-peppercorn): Flavor and culinary comparison of pink and black peppercorns.
- [Capsaicin vs Piperine](https://happyspicyhour.com/capsaicin-vs-piperine): Scientific comparison of capsaicin and piperine heat compounds.

## Culinary Guides & Comparisons

- [Dan Dan Noodles vs Mapo Tofu](https://happyspicyhour.com/dan-dan-noodles-vs-mapo-tofu): Comparison of two iconic Sichuan dishes with heat and flavor profiles.
- [Red Curry Paste vs Green Curry Paste](https://happyspicyhour.com/red-curry-paste-vs-green-curry-paste): Thai curry paste comparison guide with flavor and heat profiles.
- [Cayenne vs Turmeric Supplements](https://happyspicyhour.com/cayenne-supplements-vs-turmeric-supplements): Health benefits and dosage comparison of cayenne and turmeric supplements.

## Science & Education

- [Why Spicy Food Causes a Burning Sensation When You Pee](https://happyspicyhour.com/how-spicy-can-you-handle): Scientific explanation of capsaicin effects on TRPV1 pain receptors.
